question: Should OpenClaw reintroduce `PluginRuntime.channel.turn` as a deprecated compatibility alias for this release line, and should that alias cover only the inbound-shaped helpers in this PR or the full pre-removal `turn` helper set?
rationale: The code path is narrow and technically sound, but repository policy treats plugin API compatibility and deprecated runtime surfaces as upgrade-sensitive contracts that require maintainer intent rather than automation-only approval.

options.title: Accept Narrow Alias
options.body: Refresh the branch and land this object-identical alias for the observed old-plugin `turn.run` failures while keeping `channel.inbound.*` canonical for new code.

options.title: Expand Legacy Scope First
options.body: Before merge, restore or explicitly document older helper names such as `runPrepared`, `runAssembled`, `runResolved`, and `dispatchAssembled` if maintainers want the full pre-removal shape preserved.

options.title: Reject Core Compatibility Alias
options.body: Require affected plugins to republish against `channel.inbound.*` and close or defer this PR despite the reported old-plugin message-loss impact.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Alias
recommendation.body: Refresh the branch and land this object-identical alias for the observed old-plugin `turn.run` failures while keeping `channel.inbound.*` canonical for new code.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the removal commit for the legacy runtime alias and is the clearest history-backed owner for deciding the compatibility window and helper scope.
